items.title: Chazz Frichtel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 13, 2016
items.q: So he called my friend Doug and Doug gave him my number

ctx.x: Oh like you’re going to get paid for the date.

Yeah you’re going to get — “we would like to offer you X amount of dollars for this.” And Sunny said to me, she took me aside and said, “Man, we ought to hold out for an after contract in case this thing does go so that we could get residuals on it.” So we went to the producer and we said we’d really like an after contract. And they went, fortunately, “no problem.” And because of that, and I’ve written Sunny many times and I said, “Sunny, thank you, thank you for having the smarts and the foresight to just ask…

I love those stories because you think about the young musicians now and most of them are going the academic route, and say how do you get a break. Well? Play a Christmas party. You never know what’s going to happen.
